check: whether the 129 GameTests can silently skip for want of structure templates or resources
why: The pending run is the first execution for 23 of the 129 cases. A missing structure template or resource would not fail loudly - the case would simply not run, and the count would come out low without saying why. So the template dependency was checked before the run rather than diagnosed after.
everyCaseUsesTheSameTemplate: All 129 declare template = EMPTY_STRUCTURE, with no case using a default or a named structure.
andThatTemplateIsSuppliedByFabricApi: FabricGameTest's bytecode holds the constant fabric-gametest-api-v1:empty, so the structure comes from the API rather than from this project - there is no data/<namespace>/structure file to be missing.
theGametestSourceSetHasNoOtherResources: Its resources directory contains fabric.mod.json alone, which is consistent: the entrypoint list lives there and no structure files are needed.
whatThisRulesOut: One way a case could be counted as expected but never scheduled. Combined with the earlier checks - all six classes registered as entrypoints, none carrying a batch attribute so all fall in defaultBatch, and none constructing a stale corridor configuration - the 23 first-time cases have no known obstacle to running.
whatItDoesNotRuleOut: A case can still fail on its own logic, which is the point of running it. This check is about discovery, not correctness.
